title: Stardust Flare

outfit_card.silhouette: A fitted dark corset bodice flaring into a voluminous layered tulle skirt, with asymmetrical sheer sleeve draping and a sweeping back bustle.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A radiant gold sunburst tiara with embedded crystals and trailing starburst hairpins, plus delicate celestial ear cuffs and draped gemstone head chains.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless corseted bodice in deep onyx with intricate gold starburst beadwork, paired with sheer organza sleeves embellished with jeweled constellations and a cascading gemstone choker.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered tulle skirt with tiered gold starburst appliqués, a full bustle, and delicate lace-trimmed stockings with bejeweled garters, finished with gold-tipped stiletto heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A luminous crystal butterfly perched on the gloved hand, with floating stardust sparkles and comet-tail embroidery motifs on the skirt.
